name: Smart Admin Assistant – Dashboard and Site Enhancements
author: bdthemes

sections.description:
Smart Admin Assistant delivers powerful admin dashboard enhancements and site optimization tools in a single plugin.

Streamline your workflows with menu and dashboard customization, custom login URLs, post duplication, custom code management, SMTP utilities, login and CAPTCHA protection, role switching, database and image optimization, caching, compression, and more.

Replace multiple single-purpose plugins with one centralized solution.

Try Live Demo | Get Smart Admin Assistant Pro | Read Documentation

Why Choose Smart Admin Assistant

  • All-in-One Solution
  • Modular Architecture
  • Performance Optimized
  • Security First
  • Regular Updates and 24/7 Support
  • Multisite management from a central admin panel (Coming Soon)

Core Modules & Features

Admin Interface

Creates a cleaner, more personalized dashboard experience that reduces cognitive load and improves workflow efficiency. Remove distractions, surface important controls, and improve visibility across daily admin tasks.

  • Hiding admin bar (in Backend, on Frontend)
  • Hiding admin bar for user Roles (Pro)
  • Enabling admin bar cleanup (On/Off toggle)
  • Hiding all admin notices from plugins and WordPress
  • Enabling dashboard customization—columns layout customization (Pro)
  • Enabling menu customization—Hide, Rename, Reorder, Structure control (Pro)
  • List table enhancements in the Column of Post, Page, Media Library, User list (Pro)
  • Infinite scrolling in media library (Pro)
  • Displaying active plugins first (Pro)
  • Preserving Taxonomy Hierarchy in Classic Editor
  • Adding User Role to Body Class (Frontend)
  • Adding User Info to Admin Body Class
  • Custom Footer Text(Shortcode & Basic HTML support)

Login & User Management

Strengthens site security while giving administrators clear visibility into user access patterns. Reduce authentication risks and improve control over login and account behavior.

  • Enhancing security through URL obfuscation
  • Replacing default WordPress Login URL with custom slug
  • Restricting user login to username OR email address only
  • Login method limitation for security
  • Login page layout templates with split-screen, modern center, and underline-split designs
  • Login page styling with logo, colors, typography, and custom branding (Pro)
  • User Tracking— Last Login, IP address, and user agent (Pro)
  • Enabling logout redirection (Pro)

Performance

Improves page speed and reduces server load to support better user experience and search visibility. Optimization workflows are designed to be practical for site owners without deep technical overhead.

  • Limit the number of revisions stored for posts and pages
  • Reducing server load through API optimization
  • Database optimization through auto-clean expired Transients, auto-delete spam comments, auto-empty trash (Pro)
  • Automatic Image Optimization (Coming Soon)
  • Caching & Loading—GZIP Compression, Browser Caching (Pro)
  • Cache headers to allow browsers to cache static resources
  • Removing unnecessary whitespace and comments from HTML output
  • Preloading critical resources—hints for critical CSS and JS files

Security

Provides layered protection through security hardening and access controls to help safeguard your WordPress site from malicious activity and unauthorized access.

  • CAPTCHA verification to Login & Comment form (Pro)
  • Site-wide Password protection (Coming Soon)
  • Email address protection from spam bots
  • Removing WordPress version from meta tags, RSS feeds, etc.
  • Disabling file (Theme & Plugin) editing
  • IP management—Current status, Blocked IPs, etc.

Component Disabling

Allows selective deactivation of WordPress features and admin components you do not need, reducing overhead and creating a cleaner, more focused admin environment.

  • Disabling Gutenberg globally
  • Disabling Gutenberg for specific post types
  • Disabling comments globally
  • Disabling comments for specific post types
  • Closing comments on old content
  • HTTP security headers

Custom Code

Enables advanced customizations without editing theme files directly, helping preserve changes during updates. Centralized code management and backup support make site modifications safer and easier to maintain.

  • Code snippets management—creating, importing & exporting
  • Custom code integration status
  • Automatic CSS and JavaScript code minification (Pro)

Utilities

Simplifies maintenance with practical tools for email delivery, site availability, and URL management. Keep routine administrative tasks in one place without juggling separate plugins.

  • Configuring custom SMTP settings for email delivery (Pro)
  • Maintenance mode / Coming Soon page for non-admin users
  • Smart Auto-Redirect for 404 pages — homepage or similar post (Pro)
  • URL Redirect Manager for custom 301, 302, and 307 redirects (Pro)
  • Restoring all settings to default configuration
  • Plugin reset functionality

System Information

Provides a read-only view of your hosting environment for troubleshooting and support requests.

  • Server, PHP, and WordPress environment details in a dedicated tab
  • One-click copy system info for support tickets
  • Placed at the bottom of the modules list for quick access

Content Management

Reduces repetitive editorial work while keeping content structured and manageable. Gain better control over publishing schedules, permissions, and external link behavior.

  • One-click duplication of pages, posts, post meta, etc.
  • Allowed Roles – Administrator, Editor, Author, Contributor, Subscriber (Pro)
  • Edit Screen & List View (redirect option)
  • User Permission Management (Administration, Editor, Author, etc.)
  • Auto-generates post excerpts and customization (On/Off toggle)
  • Enable custom Ordering of hierarchical content (Pro)
  • Content organization management
  • Media replacement (Pro)
  • SVG file uploads, security sanitization, and file type support
  • SVG Uploads Roles—Administrator, Editor, Author, Contributor, Subscriber (Pro)
  • Automatic publishing trigger for posts with “missed schedule” status
  • Recovery mechanism for failed scheduled posts
  • Custom permalink functionality for external URLs
  • External URL configuration for pages, posts, and custom post types
  • Enabling External Permalinks (Pro)
  • Automatic rel=”noopener noreferrer” attribute addition
  • Enhanced user experience for external navigation
  • New tab opening for menu links with rel=”noopener noreferrer”
  • Manual IP Blocking

Additional

Extends core WordPress capabilities with specialized tools for advanced user management and future-ready enhancements, delivering flexibility that often requires multiple separate plugins.

  • Custom avatars instead of using Gravatar
  • Switching roles between users (Pro)
  • UX testing and debugging capability
  • Image size management in WordPress (Coming Soon)
  • User profiles enhancement

Who Is Smart Admin Assistant For

  • Site Owners/Administrators – Business owners, bloggers, and organizations who need specific functionality for their websites but may not have technical expertise to code solutions themselves.

  • Content Creators – Writers, marketers, and content managers who use plugins to enhance their publishing workflow, and content presentation.

  • Developers/Agencies – Web developers and agencies who use plugins as building blocks to create custom solutions for clients, extending WordPress functionality without reinventing the wheel.

  • E-commerce Users – Online store owners who rely on plugins like WooCommerce for shopping cart functionality, payment processing, and inventory management.

  • Marketing Professionals – Those using plugins for email marketing, analytics, lead generation, A/B testing, and conversion optimization.

  • Small to Medium Businesses – Companies that need professional website features like appointment booking, membership systems, or customer relationship management without custom development costs.

Smart Admin Assistant Pro

Want a cleaner, more capable WordPress admin experience?

Upgrade to unlock advanced modules, deeper customization controls, and premium productivity features at store.bdthemes.

External Services

This plugin can optionally connect to Google Search Console to display your site’s search performance (clicks, impressions, average position, top queries) on the SEO screen.

  • What it connects to: Google’s OAuth 2.0 endpoints (accounts.google.com, oauth2.googleapis.com) and the Google Search Console API (www.googleapis.com/webmasters/v3/).
  • When: Only after you paste your own Google Cloud OAuth client credentials and click “Connect Google Search Console”. No data is sent to Google unless you connect, and you can disconnect at any time from the SEO screen.
  • What is sent: Your OAuth credentials during authorization and your site’s Search Console property URL when requesting analytics data. Responses are cached locally on your site.
  • Terms & privacy: Google APIs Terms of Service, Google Privacy Policy.

Support & Documentation

  • Plugin Support: Available through WordPress.org support forums
  • Documentation: Comprehensive guides available on our website
  • Feature Requests: We listen to our community for future enhancements
sections.installation:
1. Upload the smart-admin-assistant folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Smart Admin Assistant to configure your preferred modules
  4. Review each module and enable only the features you need
  5. Save your settings and verify behavior in your admin dashboard
sections.faq:
How does Smart Admin Assistant improve WordPress site management?

It centralizes essential admin tasks, saving time and boosting productivity for a smoother, more controlled website experience.

Is this plugin suitable for beginners without technical WordPress experience?

Yes. The interface is designed to be approachable for non-technical users, with settings organized by module.

Why should I choose this plugin over similar admin tools?

It combines customization, security, performance, and content management in one extensible plugin, reducing tool sprawl and administration overhead.

Does the plugin include future feature updates after purchase?

Yes, all active licenses receive continuous updates to enhance features, improve security, and maintain compatibility.

Does it support multisite WordPress installations for centralized management?

Yes. It is optimized for multisite environments and centralized administration workflows.

How many websites can I activate with one license key?

License limits vary by plan. Choose from single-site, multisite, or unlimited activation based on your requirements.

Can I transfer my license to another domain later?

Yes. Deactivate the license on the current domain and activate it on the new domain.

Does the plugin impact my site speed or overall performance?

The plugin is lightweight and performance-focused. You can enable only the modules you need to minimize overhead.

How can I report security bugs?

Report security issues through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. Their team helps validate, triage, and coordinate responsible disclosure: Report a security vulnerability.

  • Added: Live admin menu customization — menu order, renames, and hidden items apply to the sidebar instantly

  • Changed: Site health scan streamlined by removing low-value checks
  • Security: Login protection now derives the client IP from REMOTE_ADDR only, ignoring spoofable forwarding headers unless enabled via the bdtsaa_trust_proxy_headers filter
  • Security: The image alt-text backfill now requires the edit_others_posts capability
  • Security: The SVG upload sanitizer now strips nested SVG data URIs from link attributes
  • Improved: Clearer error messages for the security scan, site health scan, and SMTP test
  • Improved: Smarter module search with synonyms, redesigned module cards, and a richer command palette
  • Improved: Redesigned configure modal with live Active/Inactive state
  • Improved: Hide Admin Notices now also covers multisite notices and script-injected banners
  • Improved: Admin scripts are cache-busted with content hashes, so updates never run stale code
  • Improved: Refined mobile navigation drawer
  • Fixed: Custom Code editor falsely flagged valid PHP as syntax errors, and PHP snippet execution could not be enabled
  • Fixed: Custom login URL edge cases — incorrect wp_login_url output, redirect loops with external targets, and scheme-less redirect URLs
  • Fixed: Google Search Console connection failed silently when all SEO toggles were off
  • Fixed: Hiding the admin bar left a blank band above the admin header
  • Fixed: The site health report’s “fix SEO issues” link opened the wrong page
